release.content: pg-backup 0.4.0 was released on 2026-11-16 from commit 5d6237768af6a5cebee1aaa7906d476e1076c459 with these changes.

rows: the WAL archive needs no key: the organization forbids service account keys, so the StatefulSet's ServiceAccount (wal.serviceaccount) acts as wal.account through Workload Identity, with an external_account credential in the ConfigMap wal.credential; wal.gcs_key_secret is gone. The WAL Secret holds libsodium-key alone (one with gcs-key.json is drift, which the fulfil fixes); setup-secrets and the fulfil make no bucket key; pg.database checks the StatefulSet's identity; a drill's restore pod runs as its scratch namespace's postgres, acting as the new read-only wal.restore_account, which terraform/wal-archive makes (restore_account_id)

release.scope: the published release v0.4.0 of pg-backup
